legal.privacyBody: This is placeholder privacy text. Secret answers are shown only to the people at that gathering and are deleted after 30 days unless the group saves them. You can delete your data from your profile at any time.

setup.rule: Points = difficulty points + speed bonus (up to 50%) + streak bonus (up to 50%). One ×2 joker.
setup.suddenRule: Questions start easy and get harder. One mistake or timeout and you're out.
setup.filledNotice: Not enough questions in your categories, so we added some from other categories.
setup.otherLangNotice: Some questions are in Arabic because there aren't enough English ones yet.
setup.repeatNotice: You've seen some of these in the last 30 days; there aren't others yet.
setup.dailyIntro: One question, the same for everyone today. You get one try.
setup.noQuestions: No questions are ready for this choice. Try other categories.

question.reportConfirm: Something wrong with this question? We'll hide it from you and review it.

question.correctWas: The answer was: {answer}. Your streak is back to zero.
